name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash

release_date.note: Raschka gallery date and HF repo creation

params.note: report: 552B backbone plus 196B Engram tables; 16B active per token in decode, 8B in prefill. Vision encoder and DSpark drafter excluded; HF safetensors 763.2B include them.

context_length.trained: 1M (sparse attention trained at 64K; context extended at 34T of 45T tokens)

tokenizer.note: tokenizer.json: ByteLevel, 128,000 base tokens plus 1,283 added

mixers.note: causal encoder: compression 2; 3 groups of 6 layers, each 1 Full + 5 Reuse
decoder: compression 1, global KV projected from the final encoder states; 5 groups of 4 (Full or Reindex, then 3 Reuse); hierarchical sparse indexer

moe.router: sqrt(softplus) scores, aux-loss-free bias with a separate bias for image tokens, top-6; routed scale 1.5

stack.note: 20-layer causal encoder (2 SWA-only + 18 CSA2) then 20-layer decoder; config kv_source_layer_ids 2, 8, 14, 20 and index_source_layer_ids mark the Full and Reindex layers

steps.label: n-gram hash lookup added into the 4 residual streams
ratio-2 compressed KV and top-512 picks; one Full layer per 6 computes them, 5 Reuse; plus a 128-token window
global KV projected from the encoder output at layer 21; Reindex layers re-rank a candidate pool, the rest Reuse; plus a 128-token window
1 shared + top-6 of 384, SwiGLU clamped at 10

specials.name: causal_encoder_decoder
specials.what: 40 layers split into a 20-layer causal encoder and a 20-layer decoder; decoder global KV comes from the final encoder hidden states, so prefill skips most decoder work

specials.name: csa2
specials.what: Compressed Sparse Attention 2: each layer is Full, Reindex or Reuse, sharing main KV and indexer keys across layers and reusing top-k indices

specials.name: sparse_topk
specials.what: later decoder indexers score only a candidate pool of up to 2,048 blocks of 8 positions chosen by the first Full layer

specials.name: engram
specials.what: two conditional-memory modules, 196B parameters in all; n-gram orders 2-4, 8 hash heads, tables of about 16M rows; short convolution omitted

specials.name: mhc
specials.what: Single-Pass mHC: 4 residual streams; the input mix for one sublayer is computed by the previous one

specials.name: mtp
specials.what: speculative decoding drafter: 3 blocks with a 128-token window, 5 draft positions, Markov head; trained after pre-training

specials.name: mxfp4
specials.what: main KV cached in FP4 (E2M1, one E4M3 scale per 16 channels); 890 bytes of global KV per token

omitted_towers.what: DeepSeek-ViT, trained from scratch: 2D-RoPE, patch 14, hidden 1024, 16 heads, 3x3 pixel-unshuffle, 2-layer MLP projector

report.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression

code.note: Block.forward: hc_mixes, hc_pre, attn_norm, attn, hc_post, then ffn; Engram applied before its layer in Transformer.forward

readme.note: CED, CSA2, Engram 196B, DSpark, 1 shared + 384 routed, MIT

gal.note: entry 'DeepSeek V4.1-Flash': date, 20 encoder + 20 decoder, 552B + 196B Engram, 8B / 16B active

unknowns.ffn.hidden_dim: no dense FFN layers: every layer holds experts
unknowns.omitted_towers: the report gives the vision encoder's shape but not its parameter count
unknowns.attention.position.theta: compressed layers use compress_rope_theta 160000 with YaRN; the two SWA-only layers use rope_theta 10000 without YaRN (code comment)

notes: Config rms_norm_eps is 1e-20, as recorded; V4-Pro uses 1e-6.
Parent is DeepSeek-V4-Pro because V4-Flash, the closer sibling, is not in this database; the report says V4.1-Flash was trained from scratch.
Config num_nextn_predict_layers 3 holds the DSpark drafter; the report says no MTP module was used in backbone pre-training.
Hash routing of V4 is absent: config has no num_hash_layers.
qk_norm: V4.1-Flash normalises the query latent and the single KV head; unlike V4-Pro it applies no per-head norm to queries (inference/model.py).

csa2_encoder.kv_source: Full layers 3, 9 and 15 (1-based); each next 5 layers reuse their KV and top-k

csa2_decoder.kv_source: layer 21 (1-based) projects global KV from the encoder output; the other 19 reuse it
csa2_decoder.note: layers 25, 29, 33, 37 re-rank; the rest reuse top-k
